correctness.rationale: Two opposite nested trace chains contribute at most b and a nonempty sets, plus empty. Sharpness uses explicit Ferrers staircase matrices. Distinct nonempty witnesses require both shores to have at least max(a,b) vertices; type count requires m+1 vertices. Unbalanced minimum-host classifications are rigid staircase matrices with a choice of b ranks below a; balanced minima are unique marked staircases plus one isolated extra vertex on one of two named sides. The balanced connectedness gap is proved by forced isolation at the unrestricted minimum; an explicit two-extra-vertex connected staircase attains the sharp bound. Exhaustive checks cover 3,932 finite chain matrices and 444,104 marking configurations up to total order 7, plus 1,680 constructive pairs up to 40 marks per side. All-size reasoning is independent of finite checks.
